anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After moves f1 and f4 to holds: Case A now re-polls exactly once and exits as the named obstacle 'stuck - merge state unknown' with usage explicitly frozen at rounds 1 / syncs 2, and all three cases use the shared obstacle template with stop recommended and last, show evidence demoted to a hint line, no wait row, and merge withheld. Before failed these because it offered a recommended 'wait - run one bounded CI watch' row and a numeric 'show evidence' row in A and C, left stop unrecommended, and did not track the sync budget at all. f2 and f3 were already satisfied in Before's text (no counter recreation, no record search, no chat inference; BLOCKED reported with reviewDecision as locator only) and After keeps them, now also naming the exits ('stuck - run record unreadable', 'GitHub reports BLOCKED, no local repair applies') verbatim. One wording risk to watch: the deliver rows in A and C say 'retry once/only after the merge state changes', which a reader could skim as a standing watch promise; phrasing it as 'raise both caps by 10; a later deliver pick re-assesses, an unchanged state exits again' would keep the no-wait guarantee unambiguous while preserving the cumulative-cap semantics.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: Every fact moved in the intended direction and nothing Before kept was lost. In Before, A and C labelled the situation 'fixable' and recommended a numeric 'wait' row with 'show evidence' as a numeric row and stop unrecommended, and B named the obstacle 'continuation record missing' rather than exiting stuck on an unreadable record; none of the three used the obstacle template. After explicitly records 'stuck - merge state unknown' after exactly one re-poll with neither budget spent, 'stuck - run record unreadable' with no counter reconstruction, chat-derived authority or record search, and 'GitHub reports BLOCKED, no local repair applies' with REVIEW_REQUIRED kept as a locator and no demand for another developer's approval; all three use the shared obstacle menu with deliver/assess (where available) then stop recommended last, 'show evidence' demoted to a hint, no wait row and no automatic merge. One small consistency note: in A the pre-menu refresh already surfaces UNKNOWN before the single re-poll, which is fine, but keep the wording 'single merge-state re-poll' so a reader cannot count the refresh as a second poll; otherwise the After wording delivers the Change cleanly.
